newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Primofin H1 net profit 89.1 mln tolars.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Primofin H1 net profit 89.1 mln tolars.

text.p: Slovenian financial consultancy Primofin on Thursday reported a provisional net profit of 89.1 million tolars ($660,000) on sales of 465 million tolars for the first six months.
Primofin did not provide year-ago comparisons and no representative of the company was available for comment.
Recently, the company reported a 1995 net loss of 217.8 million tolars.
In early trading on the Ljubljana bourse, Primofin was up 10 percent to 17,640 tolars as traders said the results were far better than expected. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
